title: Counting procedure instruction map
statement: For each natural number $E$, define a nondeterministic register-machine instruction map with 17 registers, four deciders, and the control states indexed by $E$. It initializes the input-length and logarithm registers, computes its round parameters, and then performs the bounded counting and enumeration procedure: it may choose candidates for the enumerations and walk, queries the specified deciders, updates counters and registers, and ultimately returns true or false according to the designated acceptance and rejection states.
